review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. For the Honduran reviewer: "a las seis y veinte" (telling the hour); "¿A qué hora salís?" (vos form of salir); "Son las cuatro y diez"; "los lunes"; "dice que" (reported speech); Sofía is a pupil who speaks to Sam with usted (señor).

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: What does Luis do on Mondays?

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Luis es maestro en la escuela.
sentences.english: Luis is a teacher at the school.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.english: In the morning he has coffee.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Sale de la casa a las seis y veinte.
sentences.english: He leaves the house at six twenty.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Llega a la escuela a las siete.
sentences.english: He gets to the school at seven.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: A las ocho habla con Nico.
sentences.english: At eight he talks with Nico.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: A las doce Luis tiene hambre.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.english: He eats rice, egg and tortilla.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Luis dice que la comida es barata.
sentences.english: Luis says the food is cheap.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Dice que el precio es bueno.
sentences.english: He says the price is good.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Luis sale de la escuela a las tres.
sentences.english: Luis leaves the school at three.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Porque Ana trabaja en la clínica.
sentences.english: Because Ana works at the clinic.

sentences.text: El lunes Sam llega a la escuela con Luis.
sentences.english: On Monday Sam gets to the school with Luis.

sentences.speaker: sofia
sentences.text: Mi maestro dice que usted habla muy bien.
sentences.english: My teacher says that you speak very well.

sentences.speaker: sofia
sentences.text: El maestro Luis es muy bueno.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: Do you know what time it is, Sofía?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: What do you do at nine?

sentences.text: En la tarde Sam y Luis están en la casa.
sentences.english: In the afternoon Sam and Luis are at home.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.english: It is raining a lot today.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: ¿A qué hora estás en la casa?

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Llego a las cuatro y diez.
sentences.english: I get home at ten past four.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.english: Luis, I have bread for you.

sentences.speaker: marta
sentences.text: El pan no es caro, Luis.
sentences.english: The bread is not expensive, Luis.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Yo salgo de la casa a las ocho.
sentences.english: I leave the house at eight.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Voy a la iglesia con doña Marta.
sentences.english: I go to church with doña Marta.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I speak Spanish with the families.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Yo hablo con las familias también.
sentences.english: I talk with the families too.

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Hoy es un buen día para hablar.
sentences.english: Today is a good day for talking.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Yes, I like it a lot.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Porque mi maestro es mi hermano.
sentences.english: Because my teacher is my brother.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Y mi abuela vende pan en el mercado.
sentences.english: And my grandma sells bread at the market.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Me gusta el pan de mi abuela.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Luis, what are you doing tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: luis
sentences.text: Mañana también voy a la escuela.
sentences.english: Tomorrow I am going to school too.
